Members

(module scope)

Sprite record the caller lifts onto node.plumes for updateFx.

JET_W

Jet-gradient canvas — tall narrow strip, alpha runs vertically.

jetFor

Paints the shared jet-column texture: a vertical alpha ramp blazing at the vent (the cylinder's bottom edge samples the canvas bottom — CylinderGeometry maps v=0 to the base) that dissolves through the umbrella into nothing at the rim, with a horizontal cosine roll-off softening the silhouette edges. White-only — the material color supplies the ice/sulfur tint so one texture serves every vent.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @returns A CanvasTexture, or undefined without a 2d context.

makePlumes

Builds the plume group for a def.plumes body: per-vent jet + puff sprites under one group the caller parents to the body mesh (jets inherit surface spin, so vents stay fixed over their terrain scars — Enceladus' geysers track the tiger stripes as the moon rotates).

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param def Catalog entry — plumes config + radius scale the vents.
  • @param glowTex Shared radial-glow texture for the sprites.
  • @returns { group, vents } — null without a glow texture.
